slot_m1_layer0_ambient_carrier.original_target: A question over histories factors through the report image iff it is constant on report fibers, and the factorization is unique on the image. The source statement is general and correct; its mpr direction uses Classical.choose exactly to select a representative of each fiber. This node re-derives the criterion, isolates the selector as a hypothesis (axiom-free) and records the kernel axiom report of each direction, adds the off-image non-uniqueness and surjective uniqueness boundary, and checks all report/question function pairs on 16 finite triples. The constructive listed version is the sibling node 166. claim_boundary.supports: For arbitrary types H, V, S (kernel-checked, lean4/HistoryReport.lean): factoring through the report image implies constancy on report fibers without any axiom; constancy on fibers implies factoring when a selector of a history in every nonempty fiber is supplied as a hypothesis, again without any axiom, and for an arbitrary report the selector is obtained from Classical.choice (the kernel reports Classical.choice for selector_exists and for the unconditional criterion, Quot.sound for uniqueness on the image via funext); the factor is unique on the image; two histories with one report and two answers refute factoring; off the image the extension to all reports is not unique under the hypotheses of off_image_not_unique: DecidableEq of the report type, an off-image point v0, an extension f, and a value s different from f v0 (so at least two answers); for a surjective report the extension is unique. Exhaustive native check over ALL report and question functions for 16 small (h,v,s) triples including empty and degenerate ones (including h=0, v=2, s=0 where the empty question factors through the empty image but has no extension): factoring equals fiber constancy pair by pair, factoring counts equal sum_k C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k (recomputed independently of the enumeration, with the fiber-constant count recomputed separately from set partitions), every factoring pair has exactly one factor on the image and s^(v-k) extensions. The finite native check is combinatorial corroboration only and is insensitive to the choice question, since choice is provable on finite types.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Necessity of a selector or of Classical.choice for the direction constancy => factoring (this node proves no independence or unprovability result; the selector is a hypothesis, not a construction); the constructive listed-history reconstruction (node PG-PREGEN-CONSTRUCTIVE-SUMMARY); any structure on H, V or S, probability, measurement or physical interpretation of reports.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: For arbitrary types, an answer factors through the report image iff it is constant on report fibers, uniquely on the image; the direction constancy => factoring is proved from a selector of fiber representatives (a hypothesis, axiom-free) and, for an arbitrary report, with Classical.choice; necessity of a selector or of choice is not shown; verified exhaustively on 16 small function-space triples.
claim_boundary.next_test: Decide whether constancy on fibers => factoring through the image is provable without Classical.choice for an arbitrary history type (prove it, or give a choice-free model in which a fiber-constant question fails to factor), beyond the selector hypothesis proved here and the listed-history version of node 166.
